requests.title: VPN Portal Credential Lockout & MFA Token Reset
requests.description: Received error code AUTH-401 when attempting to connect to the internal lab staging server after changing password.
requests.resolutionNotes: Reset Okta MFA session token and cleared cached Kerberos tickets. Verified candidate successfully reconnected to staging lab.

aiClassification.summary: Candidate locked out of VPN with AUTH-401 after password change.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Flush active token cache in Okta Admin and generate temporary SMS bypass.

internalNotes: [2026-08-21 02:05] Anathi Dlamini: Unlocked profile in Azure AD, user verified working.

requests.title: Temporary AWS Sandbox Access Keys for Cohort 24 Project
requests.description: Need IAM programmatic access keys for AWS S3 and Lambda deployment for the cloud backend module assignment.
requests.resolutionNotes: Provisioned temporary sandbox credentials with scoped permissions to cohort-24-dev S3 bucket and serverless execution role.

aiClassification.summary: Learner requested scoped IAM access keys for cloud module assignment.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Attach Academy Sandbox IAM policy and send encrypted credentials via secure vault.

requests.title: Zoom Enterprise Pro License Allocation for Partner Demo Webinar
requests.description: Upgrading marketing Zoom seat from basic to 500-attendee webinar tier for tomorrow morning’s corporate partner demo.
requests.resolutionNotes: Reallocated unused Zoom Enterprise Large Meeting add-on to thabo.vdm@capaciti.org and scheduled test session.

aiClassification.summary: Marketing staff requested temporary Zoom Large Meeting license for partner presentation.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Reassign available license seat in Zoom Admin Portal.

requests.title: Cape Town Campus Core Cisco Switch Power Supply Failure
requests.description: Redundant power supply in Rack B blew during thunderstorm. Switch dropped secondary uplink to lab workstations.
requests.resolutionNotes: Replacement OEM Cisco Catalyst 9300 PSU ordered from distributor arrived delayed by 24h. Installed, load tested, and secondary rail restored.

aiClassification.summary: Critical hardware failure on campus core switch secondary power supply.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Dispatch hardware technician with replacement hot-swap PSU module.

internalNotes: [2026-08-18 11:00] Tebogo Molefe: Local spare depleted. Ordered urgent courier from supplier.
[2026-08-19 13:45] Tebogo Molefe: Part arrived and installed. SLA breached due to courier logistics.

requests.title: Finance ERP Vendor Disbursement Reconciliation Glitch
requests.description: Bank payment batch file export fails with XML schema validation error when generating payments over R100,000.
requests.resolutionNotes: Identified corrupted character encoding in vendor bank branch codes. Patched XML export sanitization script and re-ran payment batches successfully.

aiClassification.summary: ERP payment export failure on high-value batches due to XML schema exception.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Debug ERP XML serializer and audit database character encoding for vendor table.

requests.title: Dual 4K Monitor Arm Hardware Replacement for Lab 3 Desk 12
requests.description: Hydraulic tension arm collapsed on workstation monitor stand, preventing proper screen positioning for cohort data lab sessions.

aiClassification.summary: Mechanical failure of monitor mount in training lab.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Replace with heavy-duty VESA dual arm stand from store room.

internalNotes: [2026-08-20 16:00] Tebogo Molefe: Warehouse out of stock, requisition sent to procurement.

requests.title: Johannesburg Campus Fiber Gateway Failover Configuration
requests.description: Setting up automated BGP failover between primary Dark Fibre Africa line and backup 5G business gateway.

aiClassification.summary: Campus network redundancy setup for secondary automated gateway switch.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Verify BGP neighbor peering table and execute simulated link drop test.

internalNotes: [2026-08-21 02:30] Zandile Nkosi: BGP route maps configured. Testing failover latency.

requests.title: GitHub Enterprise Organization Team Provisioning for AI Fellows
requests.description: Requesting access to the capaciti-ai-labs GitHub Enterprise organization and Copilot seats for 12 new AI Fellows.

aiClassification.summary: Bulk GitHub organization invitations and Copilot seat provisioning.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Map GitHub SCIM group to Azure AD AI-Fellows security group.

requests.title: Candidate Placement CRM Webhook Sync Latency Investigation
requests.description: Placement partner interview updates from Salesforce are experiencing a 45-minute delay before appearing in the Capaciti candidate portal.

aiClassification.summary: Salesforce webhook ingestion queue bottleneck delaying interview scheduling status.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Check RabbitMQ message queue depth and worker container concurrency.

requests.title: CRITICAL: LMS Assessment Portal 504 Gateway Timeout Before Mid-Term Exam
requests.description: Entire cybersecurity cohort of 40 candidates unable to load the practical assessment module. HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout returned by nginx.

aiClassification.summary: Mass student access failure to online assessment portal due to upstream proxy timeout.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Scale web app container pool to 6 replicas and flush Redis query cache.

internalNotes: [2026-08-21 02:45] Zandile Nkosi: Scaled backend pod autoscaler from 2 to 8 nodes. Validating connection pool.

requests.title: CRITICAL: Server Room Precision Air Conditioning Thermal Sensor Alarm
requests.description: HVAC unit 2 in main server facility tripped. Ambient temperature rose from 20°C to 28.5°C over the past 40 minutes.

aiClassification.summary: Server room HVAC failure threatening hardware overheating and emergency shutdown.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Switch on secondary backup split units immediately and notify facilities contractor.

internalNotes: [2026-08-21 03:15] Tebogo Molefe: Secondary cooling engaged, room temp stabilizing at 23°C.

requests.title: Swollen Battery Diagnostic for Academy Loaner Laptop #CAP-8812
requests.description: Trackpad lifting and base plate warped on Lenovo ThinkPad loaner unit. Trackpad clicks no longer register.

aiClassification.summary: Safety hazard: swollen battery casing on learner laptop.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Immediate safe disposal in fireproof container and issue swap unit from buffer stock.

internalNotes: [2026-08-21 02:00] Tebogo Molefe: Unit quarantined, preparing replacement Dell Latitude.

requests.title: Azure AD Conditional Access Policy Lockout on PowerBI Gateway
requests.description: Cannot refresh shared Capstone analytics dashboard due to location-based compliance requirement rejecting campus Wi-Fi IP range.

aiClassification.summary: Campus IP range missing from Azure AD trusted named locations list.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Add new public IPv4 egress subnet to Microsoft Entra named locations.

requests.title: Q3 Cloud Budget Allocation & FinOps Cost Center Provisioning
requests.description: Setting up departmental budget alerts and AWS Cost Explorer tags for upcoming Q3 data engineering bootcamps.
requests.resolutionNotes: AWS Budgets configured with 80% threshold notifications delivered to finance@capaciti.org and Slack #ops-alerts.

aiClassification.summary: Cloud budget ceiling and automated threshold alerts setup.
aiClassification.recommendedAction: Deploy Terraform AWS Budget template with SNS topic alerting.
